name: Progression 2: one more Blessing (the death share halved), as the engine sees it (56-review-progression.md section 2.3)
why: The Blessing ladder adds a Blessing each time lifetime hours double; each halves what a death still takes. The engine has one death share (P28), so this plays ONE rung of the ladder at every Level: the death cost x0.5. The Level-by-Level ladder is derived on the cached grid by tools/balance-program/review-progression.mjs deaths. It targets survival and pace after deaths.
